hooks.command: f=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)src/' && ! echo "$f" | grep -qiE '(^|/)tests?/'; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: src/ staged with ZERO test files. CLAUDE.md - a src change whose test population you did not check is the tell that a caller was missed (calcFeeL1 deleted with a live Alles.t.sol caller; BridgeConfig field missing from 3 test fixtures). Check, then proceed."}'; fi

hooks.statusMessage: checking whose commits are about to publish
hooks.command: d=$(git log origin/main..HEAD --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | sort -u | grep -c .); if [ "${d:-0}" -gt 1 ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: origin/main..HEAD holds commits from MORE THAN ONE session. git push HEAD:main publishes ALL of them, not just yours - a shared checkout lets a peer commit between your fetch and your commit. Run: git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD and confirm every commit is yours."}'; fi

C=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$C" | grep -qE "git +add +(-A|--all|\.( |$))|git +commit +[^|]*-a[a-z]* "; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE (rule 14): BULK STAGING in a shared checkout. Never git add -A / git add . / commit -a - several sessions edit this one tree and you will sweep their files into your commit. Stage by name."}'; fi

C=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$C" | grep -qE "(^|[^-])forge +(build|test)" && ps -eo args | grep -qE "[f]orge (build|test)"; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: a forge build/test is ALREADY RUNNING. CLAUDE.md - a second build OOMs the box, and both then fail for a reason that is not the code. Wait for it."}'; fi

C=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$C" | grep -qE "forge +test" && ! echo "$C" | grep -q "forge-test.sh"; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: raw forge test. Use tools/forge-test.sh - it pins one head and REUSES it, so Foundry's per-block cache is read instead of writing 771 dirs that never are. Raw runs burn the RPC key."}'; fi

C=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$C" | grep -qE "grep[^|]*\| *(head|tail)"; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: a TRUNCATED grep. If you are about to conclude ABSENCE from this, do not - a truncated grep proves less than an empty one and looks identical. Count with grep -c or read it all. (This is how the duplicate private-relay mechanism got built.)"}'; fi

C=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$C" | grep -qE "git +(push +[^|]*--force|reset +--(hard|soft)|revert +[^|]*-n)"; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: history-rewriting git in a SHARED tree. reset --soft staged the reversal of 26 files once; revert -n swept into a peer commit; --force discards work you cannot see. Confirm the effect, not the exit code."}'; fi

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$F" in *.t.sol) if grep -qE 'vm\.skip\(true\)' "$F" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -qE 'vm\.skip\(true\); *return' "$F" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: vm.skip(true) with no return. SESS-99 measured that vm.skip DOES NOT HALT - execution falls through into the assertions and a missing precondition reports as 0 <= 0, i.e. a routing defect. Add the return."}'; fi;; esac

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$F" in *.sol) if sed -E 's#^[[:space:]]*///[[:space:]]*@[A-Za-z]+##; s#^[[:space:]]*///##' "$F" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '@[A-Za-z]{2,}'; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"GATE: an at-prefixed word inside docblock PROSE. solc parses it as a NatSpec tag wherever it appears and backticks do not escape it; the error names the FIRST line of the docblock, tens of lines above the word. This broke the build twice - once in the sentence warning about it. Spell the tag out in words."}'; fi;; esac
